name: ethjpy-asymmetric-oscillation-inventory-risk
hypothesis: An oscillating upward 15-minute BBO path lowers near-term inventory risk relative to an oscillating downward path; the risk-aversion multiplier should move below one for the former and above one for the latter.
causal_label: future 15-minute executable-bid terminal return and minimum bid markout
sampling: last BBO per 5-minute UTC bucket; non-overlapping 15-minute effective stride
reason: The study identifies an economically relevant downside-risk ordering but does not compare strategy actions or fee-net PnL. Keep the alpha isolated until component replay supplies an incremental value estimate.
